editorial:
Imagine waking up from a dream that feels more real than your actual life. That is exactly what happens to Harrison, a guy who keeps seeing a woman from a past life. He ends up visiting Dr. Karn, a strange man who helps people move from one life to the next. The whole setup feels like a weird puzzle. You start off thinking it is just a story about reincarnation, but you quickly realize there is something much more technical and mysterious going on behind the scenes. It has a very cool, moody vibe that keeps you guessing about what is real and what is just a trick of the mind.

The acting is solid and the twists are the best part of the ride. While the middle part slows down a bit, the payoff makes it worth your time. If you like movies that make you think without being too confusing, you will love this.
endingExplained: You find out that the whole experience was actually a simulation. Dr. Karn is not a magical healer but a technician managing a digital transition. Harrison is a consciousness being moved into a new body, and the woman he loves is a glitch in the program. The movie ends with the reveal that the world we saw was a controlled environment designed to wipe memories before the next life begins.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves mind-bending stories and unexpected plot twists.
